label: PF Backlog 140
title: Tech-stack & knowledge catalog refresh (monthly) + staleness check
body:
EXISTS TODAY: core/tech_stack.py (KNOWN_TECHS, detect/build_decision/stack_to_layers), core/techstack_guidelines.py (TECHSTACK_DEFINITIONS + generator), core/service_catalog.py (SERVICE_CATALOG), core/target_advisor.py / integration_advisor.py, core/knowledge_router.py + core/knowledge_compiler.py, docs/knowledge/compiled/*.json, docs/guidelines/business/*.md. GAP: no scheduled/periodic refresh + no staleness check, so NEW/evolving tech stacks do not flow into the catalog automatically. ADD: a monthly refresh job (default 30d, configurable) that researches new/updated tech stacks, frameworks, DBs, services and best practices and appends them to the catalogs with source + version + fetched_at; a staleness check that warns when a catalog entry is older than the window; and a review/approve path before new entries become recommendable. Reuse core/domain_research + knowledge_compiler (refer-then-learn).
API-FIRST (owner convention): expose via the backend API; the dashboard consumes only the API.

dashboard_impact.reason: New/updated tech stacks + staleness must be reviewable/approvable in the dashboard.

_note: done: core/knowledge_refresh (seed 30 techs + staleness 30d) + refresh_catalog stage 0b hook
